title: Rich Potato Crumble
description: A creamy potato dish topped with a crunchy crumble. Perfect for a comforting vegetarian meal.
instructions: 2. Peel and dice the potatoes into 1-inch pieces.
3. In a large pan, melt the rich over medium heat. Add the diced potatoes.
4. Cook the potatoes for 10-12 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
5. Transfer the potatoes to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
6. In a separate bowl, mix the crumble topping ingredients. Sprinkle over the potatoes.
7. Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and crispy.
